description: Header file defining the absl::poisson_distribution class template for generating Poisson-distributed random variates, including parameter management, distribution algorithms, and I/O operators.

classes.name: poisson_distribution
classes.description: A template class for generating Poisson-distributed random variates with configurable integer result type.

classes.name: poisson_distribution::param_type
classes.description: Parameter class encapsulating the mean of the Poisson distribution and precomputed values for sampling algorithms.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates a Poisson-distributed random variate using the provided random number generator and distribution parameters.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Gets or sets the distribution parameters.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Returns the mean parameter of the distribution.
